summary: Persona entity is the field-meaning authority for CanonicalPersona as CanonicalEntity persona PersonaBody, the user identity counterpart to character sharing prompt injection but first person user not third person char. schema.ts owns types; this page owns meanings and producers. How to read the field tables repeats docs-fields conventions. Composition is flatter with required name content and optional nested shapes; four adapters RoleCall SillyTavern Lumiverse Marinara ship today with RoleOut PNG pending. Core content separates brief never inject from content inject text and keeps sections both. Identity covers free-text age and Lumiverse pronounSet. Presentation is RoleCall theming and imageUrl. Knowledge, rating, and chat injection links lorebooks ContentRating and dual position dialects. Attribution uses ISO createdAt. Media is studio portrait only. PersonaBody assembles all fields. sections.title: How to read the field tables
sections.summary: Field tables are generated by scripts/docs-fields.ts and embedded verbatim; never hand-edit a cell, improve the schema doc comment and regenerate. Field is the canonical name with trailing question mark for optional. Type is the schema TypeScript type. Producers lists source formats or dash when untagged including universal name content brief. Meaning explains purpose; blank cells are self-evident primitives. Richer explanation lives only in surrounding prose never inside a cell.

sections.title: Composition
sections.summary: PersonaBody is flatter than CharacterBody: required name and content plus eleven optional fields. Six nest named shapes sections identity presentation chatInjection attribution media; the rest are scalars or reference lists. Full table is under PersonaBody. Four adapters produce personas today RoleCall two shapes SillyTavern Lumiverse and Marinara. Legacy RoleOut PNG and foreign-V2/V3-card-as-persona are specced in specs formats personas but have no shipped adapter and rolecall format lists them pending. Tables come from docs/generated/fields.persona.md.

sections.title: Core content
sections.summary: Core content is the persona voice and shelf discovery. name is the canonical identifier. brief is the short library-card blurb and is NEVER the injected text. content is the full first-person text injected as user voice. Swapping brief and content was a live RoleCall production bug; every codec replicates the fix not the bug. sectionOrder is creator display order for sections; traits are RC personality-descriptor tags. sections is a structured alternative source for content; canonical keeps both unlike source formats content-wins rule so the editor can structure-edit flat sources. Compiling sections into content is codec serialize work in fixed order appearance body personality quirks history as Label text blocks. Sections child lists those five optional string fields.

children.title: Sections
children.summary: PersonaSections holds optional appearance body personality quirks and history strings that codecs may compile into content at serialize time in that fixed order as labeled blocks for structured editing of the user persona voice.

sections.title: Identity
sections.summary: Identity holds RoleCall casting-card attributes: tagline age as free text never int height pronouns as free-text display for RC ST round-trip and pronounSet as Lumiverse structured triplet additive elsewhere. Pronoun set child is subjective objective possessive strings engines can conjugate with, distinct from free-text pronouns.

children.title: Pronoun set
children.summary: PersonaPronounSet is Lumiverse structured pronouns with required subjective objective and possessive strings for engine conjugation, additive and absent on other producers unlike free-text pronouns.

sections.title: Presentation
sections.summary: Presentation is RoleCall visual identity: signatureColor, colors as character Swatch array, and imageUrl as external image URL for JSON export. PNG export instead carries the image as the file body itself using the same binary-carrier pattern architecture describes for character portraits.

sections.title: Knowledge, rating, and chat injection
sections.summary: knowledgeRefs links ordered canonical lorebook ids by reference never inline copy same as CharacterBody. rating reuses ContentRating; RoleCall wire is two-way all_hours after_dark so mature narrows to after_dark on RC export a documented one-way loss. chatInjection places content with position open union covering RoleCall world character scene depth and SillyTavern prompt author_note_top author_note_bottom in_chat none plus depth role and RC wrapper injection_prefix. Platform lens visibility is injectionsForProfile in core persona platform-fields never UI hardcodes.

sections.title: Attribution
sections.summary: Attribution holds credit and provenance for the persona: optional creator version createdAt and source. createdAt is ISO 8601 text not unix seconds because the rcpersona wire itself carries strings. source is an open origin platform tag such as rolecall sillytavern or custom. This is distinct from CharacterBody attribution createdAt which uses numeric unix seconds.

sections.title: Media
sections.summary: Media is studio-side only. media.portrait is the same slot CharacterBody media.portrait fills so the studio portrait resolver can read a data-URI MediaAsset from in-editor upload. Codecs map explicit fields only so this portrait never leaks into a foreign wire format.

sections.title: PersonaBody
sections.summary: PersonaBody assembles every field: required name and content; optional brief never inject; sections both kept with content; sectionOrder traits; identity presentation knowledgeRefs rating chatInjection attribution and media portrait. Table meanings restate brief content distinction sections compile rule knowledgeRefs reference-not-inline rating map and studio media. This is the top shape codecs and the studio editor read and write.

sections.title: What rides escrow, not a field
sections.summary: Unmodeled source facts stay in original formatId raw for same-format lossless round trip; cross-format carries only body. Rides escrow: RoleCall private ids and unmapped extensions.rolecall keys; every other persona in a SillyTavern personas backup because one entity per file imports only default or first persona and export overlays the edited one so the sealed rest re-emit byte-true; Lumiverse folder is_narrator metadata timestamps; Marinara whole game layer theming stat bars avatar crop tags and scenario with no canonical home. Does NOT ride escrow: pronounSet chatInjection sections identity presentation which are first-classed and survive cross-format.
